components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored
            and returned value is this E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The stored and returned value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rejection rule for `POST /api/owners`. The change rejects creating an owner when another owner already has the same `lastName` **and** the same `address` (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace), returning **409 Conflict** — unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

Following the codebase's existing `DuplicateOwnerTelephoneException` pattern, I made four changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema. DTOs are generated from this spec, and Spring Boot ignores unknown JSON by default, so the field must be a real DTO property for the controller to read it. `writeOnly: true` keeps it out of owner responses.

2. **`DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException.java`** (new) — A `RuntimeException` carrying the conflicting canonical last name/address, mirroring the existing telephone exception.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — Added a `rejectDuplicateHousehold(...)` check (skipped when `sharesHousehold` is true), plus a `canonicalizeHousehold(...)` helper that trims, collapses internal whitespace to a single space, and lower-cases with `Locale.ROOT` before comparing against existing owners.

4. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — Added a handler that renders the new exception as a 409 via the existing `conflict(...)` helper, with an `errors` array of `["lastName", "address"]`, matching the shape of the other owner-creation error responses.

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rejection rule for `POST /api/owners`. The change rejects creating an owner when another owner already has the same `lastName` **and** the same `address` (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace), returning **409 Conflict** — unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

Following the codebase's existing `DuplicateOwnerTelephoneException` pattern, I made four changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema. DTOs are generated from this spec, and Spring Boot ignores unknown JSON by default, so the field must be a real DTO property for the controller to read it. `writeOnly: true` keeps it out of owner responses.

2. **`DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException.java`** (new) — A `RuntimeException` carrying the conflicting canonical last name/address, mirroring the existing telephone exception.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — Added a `rejectDuplicateHousehold(...)` check (skipped when `sharesHousehold` is true), plus a `canonicalizeHousehold(...)` helper that trims, collapses internal whitespace to a single space, and lower-cases with `Locale.ROOT` before comparing against existing owners.

4. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — Added a handler that renders the new exception as a 409 via the existing `conflict(...)` helper, with an `errors` array of `["lastName", "address"]`, matching the shape of the other owner-creation error responses.
